parsed.explanation: The unit responds to the side door-window area of real, upright road vehicles: the door glass with a clearly defined frame and pillars, mostly the front cab/driver window, seen from a front or rear three-quarter angle.
parsed.evidence: Within classes, the strongest separations are for a clearly visible side window (d +0.87, 99th percentile), a clearly visible frame and pillars (d +0.74, 99th percentile vs -0.64 when unclear), three-quarter views (d +0.67, 97th percentile), and real intact vehicles (d +1.25 vs -1.25 for toys or models). parsed.missing_data: Photos with no vehicle, or with similar framed glass on non-vehicles (building windows, train or boat cabins), plus tight close-ups of door windows, to test whether the unit needs vehicle context and how specific it is to car doors.

null_s2.explanation: The unit responds to the clearly delineated side-window region of a vehicle: door glass bounded by a visible frame and pillars, most often the front cab/driver door window. It extends somewhat to rear passenger or cargo windows and to boxier vehicles such as trucks and buses.

parsed.explanation: The unit responds to the clearly delineated side-window region of a vehicle: door glass bounded by a visible frame and pillars, most often the front cab/driver door window. It extends somewhat to rear passenger or cargo windows and to boxier vehicles such as trucks and buses.
parsed.evidence: Within-class activity is higher when the side window is clearly visible (d +0.33, pct 92) and the frame/pillars are distinct (d +0.30, pct 92), and lower when only the windshield or rear window shows (d -0.56, pct 2) or the frame is unclear (d -0.41, pct 6). Viewing angle separates poorly (pct 38), and three-quarter views are slightly below average, which contradicts the 'front three-quarter' part of the original description.
parsed.missing_data: Isolated door-window crops, or non-vehicle framed windows such as building windows, would show whether the unit needs vehicle context or just a framed glass-pane-with-pillars pattern. Activations on classes outside the vehicle categories would also help.
